domain: Echelon 3 Core Infrastructure and Ecology / Assets/_Project/Scripts/World / DestructibleOrganicManager.cs

fixedFindings.problem: SlowTick called RefreshActiveCachesIfNeeded(force: true) after every persistence sync. That forced both active vegetation lanes through SyncLane under the full organic lifecycle lock even when persistence maps and bridge revisions were logically unchanged.
fixedFindings.fix: Destroyed-flora and flora-state persistence sync now return a dirty flag based on logical UID map changes. SlowTick only forces cache refresh when those maps changed; normal bridge revision changes still sync through force:false.

fixedFindings.problem: Flora state override sync ignored TryAdd failures for the persisted health and height-scale UID maps. A capacity/probe failure could leave one side of the pair present and the other absent.
fixedFindings.fix: Override sync compares the desired persisted pair against the existing pair, preserves the first valid duplicate UID pair, treats capacity/probe insertion as atomic, removes both entries on partial capacity failure, reports telemetry, and forces a cache refresh when the logical pair state changes.

buildVerification.blockedReason: AGENTS.md forbids dotnet build/Roslyn while CPU is above 50% or compiler processes are active. Workspace root also has no Unity-generated .csproj files, so dotnet build would stop before C# source compilation.
